craft_notes: Sthāyin: oracle-joy. Close: form. Rejected: 'prophesies' — killed: tells plain; 'deity' — 'god-form' kept.

lines: Asked, he tells the past and future — ere three hours pass,
l4.sanskrit_cite: atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo 'sau kathayaty api | praharād yad abhipretaṃ devatārūpam uccaran

reads_against.argmap: Asked, he tells past and future; within a watch, the meant god-form uttered.
c1_essence: Asked tells past-future; within a watch, god-form uttered.
